title: 10 Lectures and 42 Open Problems — Matrix version of 6 deviations suffice
exact_target: Can signs always be chosen so that the operator norm of the signed sum of n symmetric n-by-n contractions is at most a universal constant times the square root of n?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2800403 (AMR-027-0403). CC BY 4.0.
Nikhil Bansal, Haotian Jiang and Raghu Meka, Resolving Matrix Spencer Conjecture Up to Poly-logarithmic Rank (2022), arXiv:2208.11286, Section 1, Conjecture 1.2, p. 1.
